32.   EVENTS OCCURRING AFTER THE BALANCE SHEET DATE
Subsequent to the reporting date, Asiri Hospital Holdings PLC, the parent company of the Company, reduced
its shareholding in the Company from 79.96% to 64.74% through the disposal of a portion of its equity interest.
However, Asiri Hospital Holdings PLC continues to retain control and remains the parent company of the
Company.
Except for the matter described above, there were no events occurring after the reporting date that require
adjustment to, or disclosure in, these financial statements.
